summary: Implemented the rich.progress file-reading feature without committing or running any tests. Changes: rich/progress.py gains a private _BinaryReader (io.RawIOBase subclass) with explicit read-side methods that advance the task by bytes returned, seek that sets completed, tell, write refusal, and an owned/caller-owned close; a private generic _ReadContext that starts and stops Progress around the reader; a shared _make_read_progress helper; module-level open and wrap_file beside track(); and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file next to track(). tests/test_progress.py gains 22 tests covering the acceptance criteria. docs/source/progress.rst gains "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" sections. CHANGELOG.md gains one Unreleased/Added entry without a PR link. Choices to review: the binary return type is io.RawIOBase rather than BinaryIO; readinto is implemented via handle.read because BinaryIO lacks readinto; a failed os.stat raises ValueError; and Progress.open creates the task before opening the file, so a bad path can leave an orphan task. Nothing was executed, so tests, black, and mypy are unverified.
